name: gettogether-app
description: GetTogether samlet af Malik som Android-app til Google Play (Capacitor).

scripts.android:opret: npm run web && cap add android && capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor #0B1220 --iconBackgroundColorDark #0B1220 --splashBackgroundColor #0B1220 --splashBackgroundColorDark #0B1220 && node scripts/indstil.mjs
scripts.klar: npm run web && cap sync && node scripts/indstil.mjs
scripts.android: npm run klar && cap open android
